description: config_value changes in src/lib.rs. schema.proto is an unsupported-language file that textually mentions config_value in a comment; the extractor has no .proto grammar, so this reference is an expected unknown rather than an edge.

known_gaps.description: schema.proto has no registered extractor (Protocol Buffers is not among the supported languages), so its textual mention of config_value is completely invisible: the file contributes nothing to files_indexed, show(file:schema.proto) resolves to null, and search for config_value only matches src/lib.rs.
